- **WeatherAPI.com** – Their “Forecast API” also supports hourly data for up to 10 days.
- **AccuWeather** – Offers detailed hourly forecasts via their API (requires a subscription).

Once you have an API key, you can make a request like:

```
https://api.openweathermap.org/data/2.5/onecall?lat=37.8651&lon=-119.5383&exclude=current,minutely,daily,alerts&units=metric&appid=YOUR_API_KEY
```

This will return JSON containing hourly temperature, wind speed, and precipitation probabilities for the next 10 days. If you’d like help formatting the request or interpreting the response, just let me know!
